thread:
maria.k: Hey team — pinging for eyes on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-configs/pull/482. This is the new onboarding/config for 'halcyon-lite' (tokenizer tweaks + short sequence profile). Hoping to merge today so Dedicated can pick it up for next rollout. Quicknotes: tokenizer merges a new vocab patch, adds fallback unk-handling, and changes default max_length to 1024.
aj: I can take a look after stand — probably in ~45m. Any specific parts you want me to focus on?
maria.k: Thanks! Focus on tokenizer encode/decode edge cases and the quant profile compatibility lines in config.yaml. Also CI fails on perf-suite sometimes; don't block on perf flakiness but flag anything obviously wrong.
samir: skimming now. Quick q: why bump max_length? that impacts KV cache layout and perf.
maria.k: We saw several threads where truncation caused hallucinations — 1024 reduces truncation. Benchmarks showed little throughput drop with current batching, but worth double-checking.
elaine: heads up CI: `ci-bot` just posted failure on the integration job.
ci-bot: Build #482 failed — logs: `pytest tests/tokenizer/test_encode.py::test_empty_input` failed (timeout). https://ci.redwood/482
aj: can you paste the failing trace? I saw similar yesterday due to a stray None return.
maria.k: Here's the snippet that reproduced locally:
```
> enc = tokenizer.encode(None)
> TypeError: object of type 'NoneType' has no len()
```
maria.k: I added a guard in tokenizer.py L128 but maybe missing in one codepath.
samir: I left a tiny nit in the PR — prefer `if text is None: text = ''` rather than catching TypeError later. Saves a branch in hot path.
elaine: I'll do a quick review for the profile YAML after lunch. If no objections I can approve after CI green.
aj: I pushed a small commit fixing the None guard and added a unit test for empty input.
maria.k: awesome, thanks. re-running CI.
ci-bot: Build #483 queued.
aj: also added a short comment re: changelog entry — can someone from product sign off on the wording? @elaine ?
elaine: I can approve wording — looks fine to me :+1:
samir: I approve the tokenizer logic change, but please update the quant profile comment to mention that padding tokens are preserved for KV alignment.
maria.k: done — pushed update. anyone else available to do a final pass on the quant bits?
aj: I can check quant comments in 10.
aj: LGTM on code, leaving formal approval to samir for quant and elaine for docs.
ci-bot: Build #483 passed — all checks green :tada:
maria.k: merging now. Thanks everyone!
elaine: congrats. please mention in release notes.
samir: nice, will watch the Dedicated rollout metrics tomorrow.
